articles.summary: 2027 will be a major year for Spy x Family as the anime is set to return with both its fourth season and a new movie to mark the fifth anniversary of the television adaptation. articles.summary: The Spy x Family Anime Extra Mission II special event announced a fourth season and a second theatrical movie on Sunday, revealing the production staff and a teaser visual (pictured) for Season 4.
